correctness.rationale: Hypergeometric one-species marginal identity yields exact mean plug-in entropy. Every positive integer partition and every equal-richness unordered pair up to 15 organisms is generated exactly. Integer vectors of prime-log coefficients, rigorous rational atanh log intervals, and fail-closed signs certify the two sign changes and uniqueness without floating-point assumptions; independently enumerate labelled sample subsets for witness checks. Infinite-domain behavior is not asserted.

value.rationale: Finite ecological Shannon entropy accumulation rankings can change with sample size even after controlling both total census size and species richness. The complete sharp first-order threshold and unique extremal pair identify structural sample-depth sensitivity of a widely used frequency-sensitive index. The three strict regimes are not derivable from richness-only accumulation, and the calculation is a natural finite classification rather than an arbitrary profile-specific invariant. Effect size and field detectability are separate limitations.
